description: This collection records decoded CAN-bus measurements from a Tümosan 81.110 Powershuttle tractor during soil tillage in Türkiye’s Konya Plain. Tümosan and Yildiz Technical University researchers publish ten field-session tables at a nominal ten-hertz sampling rate, totalling about 24.7 hours and 889,255 samples. Signals include engine speed and torque, fuel use, temperatures, vehicle speed and implement-related states. Mendeley version 3 provides tab-separated files with documentation, a signal database and supporting scripts free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is high-load tillage selected from a roughly year-long acquisition campaign, with exact dates unestablished. Exclusion of transport and idling is a limitation for whole-fleet energy estimates. A reviewer-assessed use is building load cycles for machinery electrification, thermal checks and agricultural energy simulations. model-system-advisor-model-sam is a related energy-storage resource, without verified load conversion. No field traces or code were downloaded or executed.
